rounds.q: In 2025, what % of US Thanksgiving travelers were set to go by car?
rounds.why: AAA expected at least 73 million of 2025's 81.8 million Thanksgiving travelers to drive.
rounds.fun: About 89% go by car. That is at least 73 million people on one big road trip!

rounds.q: What % of Americans plan to eat Thanksgiving dinner at someone else's home?
rounds.why: Another 34% planned to eat at their own home, and just 3% at a restaurant or other public place.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Thanksgiving survey of 9,609 US adults (Nov 2024 data)
rounds.fun: 39% pull up a chair at someone else's home, and only 3% go out to eat.

rounds.q: Of Americans having Thanksgiving away from home, what % travel under an hour?
rounds.why: Only 6% of US adults expected a Thanksgiving trip of three hours or more.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, Thanksgiving survey of 9,609 US adults (Nov 2024 data)
rounds.fun: For 69% of dinner guests, the feast is under an hour away. Short trip, long meal.

rounds.q: In 2025, how many million Americans were set to travel for Thanksgiving?
rounds.why: AAA forecast a record 81.8 million people going 50 miles or more from home.
rounds.fun: A record 81.8 million people, all heading 50 miles or more toward a full plate.

rounds.q: At the busiest time of day, how many planes are in the sky over the US?
rounds.why: The FAA handles 44,360 flights on an average day and counts 19,482 US airports.
rounds.src: FAA, Air Traffic by the Numbers (fiscal year 2024 data)
rounds.fun: About 5,500 planes up there at once, out of 44,360 flights a day. Look up and wave!
